cpsFeature.note: The chrome-platform-showcase suite at conformanceRoute governs only the assertions it explicitly lists; it does not prove unasserted native, hardware, permission, backend, or other behavior. gendn references that listed contract without forking it.

assertions.describe: The stable route /v147/web-printing-api/ responds 200 (durable-demo contract).
Page retains chromestatus.com/feature/5146307550248960 as the Isolated Web Apps prerequisite link; additive exact assertions protect canonical Web Printing identity 5100352332627968.
Document has a non-empty <title> for the reference page.
Exactly one <h1> — the API name (listing name), MDN-shaped article heading.
A single <main> landmark wraps the article content.
Shared editorial design system /public/styles.css is linked.
Responsive viewport meta present (width=device-width) for mobile+desktop parity.
Breadcrumb links back to the /v147/ release index.
Byline footer present (article provenance).
Every target=_blank link carries rel=noopener (no reverse-tabnabbing; MDN-style external link hygiene).
No anchor has an empty or placeholder (#) href.
assertions.test: [...document.querySelectorAll('a')].every(el => { const h = el.getAttribute('href'); return h && h !== '#'; })

assertions.describe: Page loads with no console errors.
No failed (>=400 / net-error) network requests on load.
No unintended horizontal overflow at desktop (1280x800).
No unintended horizontal overflow at narrow mobile (360x740, DPR3).
Desktop render is legible, contrast passes WCAG AA, controls/text not clipped (screenshot review).
Mobile render is legible with adequate tap targets and no clipped text/controls (screenshot review).
The <h1> is the chromestatus milestone-listing name for this feature (not the broader detail name) — factual/source fidelity.
Frontend implementation consulted modern-web-guidance for its UI/responsive/a11y topics and applied or justified them (recorded in _questions.json guidanceConsulted).
Built reference has at least three <h2> sections (MDN-shaped depth).
Cross-browser support is documented (a support/compat/baseline section, or a reference table stating Baseline / Shipped-in / standards positions) — accurate messaging, not implied support.
Built reference includes a usable example surface (<pre> code and/or a live embed).
Code/IDL examples are correctly escaped (no attribute/element injection, invariant #4) and trace to the cited spec/IDL — no invented members (source review).
The overview links the source-derived entry point, printer, print-job, and type reference routes so a reader can reach the complete local API inventory.
The overview explicitly distinguishes the current source-declared window.printing / submitPrintJob surface from the legacy navigator.printing / printJob overview wording.
The first ChromeStatus feature link identifies Web Printing API 5100352332627968 as the canonical feature; it is not the Isolated Web Apps prerequisite record.
The Isolated Web Apps ChromeStatus record 5146307550248960 remains linked and is labelled as a prerequisite context rather than the Web Printing API identity.
The source-derived inventory identifies Window.printing as normative and labels Chromium WindowOrWorkerGlobalScope as an implementation divergence with unknown worker usability.
assertions.test: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('a[href="entry-point/"]')?.closest('tr')?.textContent || ''; return row.includes('Window.printing') && row.includes('implementation divergence') && row.includes('worker usability is unknown'); })()

assertions.describe: The overview links the exact WebPrintingMediaSizeDimension typedef reference, including its range-or-unsigned-long conversion guidance.

Compatibility explicitly says Proposed/not released, does not use I2S desktop 147 as release proof, limits the current service implementation to ChromeOS+CUPS, and records Android as null/no public mobile release.
assertions.test: (() => { const text = document.querySelector('#compatibility')?.textContent || ''; return text.includes('Proposed and not released') && text.includes('not release proof') && text.includes('ChromeOS') && text.includes('USE_CUPS') && text.includes('Android') && text.includes('null'); })()

assertions.describe: Canonical feature identity is immutable Web Printing 5100352332627968.
Overview links every inventory item’s stable local route.
The exact WebPrintingMediaSizeDimension typedef has its own route and is linked from the overview.
IWA is retained only as prerequisite context and the service caveat names ChromeOS+CUPS.
Compatibility explicitly records Android null/no public mobile release.
Overview links exact Window, manager/job, attributes/enums, converter, build, and runtime source files.
Compatibility separates proposal status, I2S target, implementation guard, and Android status.
The immutable shared-values index remains linked for legacy readers, while the exact WebPrintingMediaSizeDimension route is linked separately.
Compatibility evidence is evaluated on the enclosing semantic section, not only the heading: it separates proposal status, I2S target, ChromeOS+CUPS service guard, and Android null status.
Prose explicitly calls IWA a prerequisite context and separates it from the canonical Web Printing feature identity.
assertions.test: (()=>{const t=document.querySelector(".lede")?.textContent||"";return t.includes("IWA prerequisite context")&&t.includes("not this API’s canonical feature identity")&&document.querySelector("a[href*=\"5146307550248960\"]")&&document.querySelector("a[href*=\"5100352332627968\"]")})()

assertions.describe: Web Printing’s exact canonical ChromeStatus record is 5100352332627968; the older IWA record 5146307550248960 is retained only as historical prerequisite context.
assertions.test: (()=>{const l=[...document.querySelectorAll(".lede a")];const canonical=l.find(a=>a.href.includes("5100352332627968"));const iwa=l.find(a=>a.href.includes("5146307550248960"));return canonical?.textContent.trim()==="Web Printing API"&&!!iwa&&document.querySelector(".lede")?.textContent.includes("IWA prerequisite context")})()
